heading: Our Culinary Heritage
storyParagraph1: Founded in 2018 in the heart of the city's cultural quarter, AURA was born from a singular passion: to elevate regional fine dining through bold, uninhibited flavor pairings and ancient wood-fire techniques.
storyParagraph2: Under the guidance of Executive Chef Alexander Vance, every dish is an ode to micro-seasonal agriculture, sustainable seafood harvesting, and rare heirloom botanicals sourced directly from our network of artisanal smallholders.
philosophy: We believe dining is a sensory ritual. From the crackle of open white-oak fires to the delicate balance of acidity and texture on your plate, every detail is engineered to evoke emotion, memory, and lingering delight.

highlights.title: Ancestral Wood-Fire Cooking
highlights.description: Slow-seared over aged white oak, hickory, and fruitwood coals for deep, natural smoky character.

highlights.title: Hyper-Seasonal Sourcing
highlights.description: Daily harvests from local biodynamic farms within 50 miles of our kitchen doors.

highlights.title: Sommelier Pairings
highlights.description: A cellar featuring iconic vintages alongside biodynamic, natural micro-cuvées from boutique vineyards.

highlights.title: Bespoke Chef's Table
highlights.description: An intimate multi-course tasting experience overlooking our open theatre kitchen.
